scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run test:unit:backend && pnpm run test:unit:frontend
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && pnpm --dir frontend run build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run test:integration:up && pnpm run test:integration:test && pnpm run test:integration:down
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
